messages:
ryan_partnerships: FYI getting blocked on SkyBridge PO — their signer rotated and our marketplace flow rejects the ACK. Customer is on a tight launch window (next Tue). Can we unblock?

alex_jaffe: saw the webhook errors earlier, `422 ACCEPT_WINDOW_EXPIRED` from marketplace. They rotated signer yesterday and the portal sent a new signer fingerprint we don't have mapped.

marta_ops: which PO id? I'll pull the ledger and vendor mapping.

ryan_partnerships: PO# SB-2026-0187 — flow failed at `ack` stage, vendor returns `signer_mismatch`. Ticket attached: https://tickets.redwood/PA-12345

procurement_bot: Automated note: PO SB-2026-0187 — external vendor signer fingerprint 0x9fA2... differs from recorded 0x4bC1... Accept window closed at 2026-03-23T14:03:00Z.

alex_jaffe: copying the important part of the inbound payload:```xml
<PurchaseOrder id="SB-2026-0187">
  <Vendor signer_fp="0x9fA2..."/>
  <Signature time="2026-03-23T14:05:12Z"/>
</PurchaseOrder>
```

sarah_legal: Is this a signer identity change or a delegated signing authority? If it's delegation we can accept affidavit + audit log as a one-off. If they completely replaced entity keys, we need a new vendor alias flow.

devon_sales: customer (SkyBridge) says their treasury rotated keys last night for security; they can e-sign an affidavit today but need the PO accepted before Tue launch. Can legal sign off fast?

marta_ops: I can remap the alias if procurement confirms the new fingerprint and we get a signed affidavit PDF. But the marketplace portal will still reject previous ACKs — we need to resend the accept with the new signer within the portal TTL.

procurement_bot: Suggested action: 1) procure team to request signed affidavit from SkyBridge, 2) partnerships to request vendor portal resend after alias update, 3) legal to review affidavit.

sarah_legal: I'll review affidavit today. If it contains the org name, authorized signer list, and signature timestamp, I can approve a temporary acceptance clause. Send to legal@redwood with subject "SkyBridge signer affidavit SB-2026-0187".

alex_jaffe: ops note: when we update alias mapping we should run `vendor-sync --force --vendor SB-2026-0187` to push the new fingerprint to our staging portal before asking them to resend.

marta_ops: agreed. I'll coordinate with procurement. Expect mapping + staging push within 2 hours once affidavit is uploaded.

ryan_partnerships: plan: procurement to get affidavit and upload, marta to run `vendor-sync` + request portal resend, sarah to approve waiver, devon to keep customer updated. If any step slips we escalate to partnerships manager for an emergency manual accept.

devon_sales: I'm on standby for customer comms. Please ping me when affidavit is in. :thumbsup:

sarah_legal: ping me here once affidavit uploaded. I'll prioritize review.

marta_ops: upload landed: https://files.redwood/sb/affidavits/SB-2026-0187-affidavit.pdf — starting `vendor-sync` now.

procurement_bot: vendor-sync job started (job id: 87921). Estimated completion ~2m.

alex_jaffe: sync finished, portal staging updated. Requesting SkyBridge resend now.

ryan_partnerships: customer confirmed resend, portal accepted ACK this time. Marking thread resolved unless legal asks for follow-up. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:

sarah_legal: reviewed affidavit, good to go. Stamping approval. Leaving a note for audit.

marta_ops: closing mapping ticket.

devon_sales: celebratory 🎉 — launch on track.
